subject: The Empress (Netflix)
query: is the empress on netflix a true story
title: Is The Empress on Netflix a true story? The real Sisi, explained
answer: Yes, mostly. Netflix's The Empress (German title: Die Kaiserin) is based on the real life of Empress Elisabeth of Austria, known as Sisi, and her marriage to Emperor Franz Joseph I, but it invents and rearranges many scenes. The third and final season arrives on Netflix on Thursday, Nov. 12, 2026.
body:
The real Elisabeth was born on Dec. 24, 1837, in Munich and married Franz Joseph on April 24, 1854, in Vienna. The German series, created by Katharina Eyssen, stars Devrim Lingnau as Elisabeth and Philip Froissant as Franz Joseph. Season 1 premiered on Sept. 29, 2022, and Season 2 on Nov. 22, 2024.

According to Netflix, Season 3 opens after the Sardinian War, with Franz Joseph returning traumatized. Elisabeth leaves Vienna to recover on a distant island and meets Hungarian leader Count Andrássy, while Franz Joseph's brother Maximilian heads to Mexico to take a throne. Those threads are rooted in history: in October 1860 a lung specialist advised Elisabeth to stay on Madeira; Gyula Andrássy, whom she backed, became Hungary's first prime minister after the 1867 compromise; and she was crowned Queen of Hungary on June 8, 1867. Maximilian became Emperor of Mexico on April 10, 1864, and was executed in Querétaro on June 19, 1867.

The show takes liberties. There is no evidence that Maximilian conspired against his brother, as the series depicts. In real life, Elisabeth first met Franz Joseph indoors over tea in Bad Ischl with relatives present, and he did not propose in public. Franz Joseph's brother Karl Ludwig, who was in love with Elisabeth, does not appear at all.
in_the_news: The third and final season of Netflix's German period drama The Empress premieres Nov. 12, 2026.

faq.q: Was Empress Sisi a real person?
faq.a: Yes. Elisabeth of Austria (1837-1898), nicknamed Sisi (also spelled Sissi), was empress of Austria and, from 1867, queen of Hungary.

faq.q: Is Count Andrássy a real person?
faq.a: Yes. Gyula Andrássy became Hungary's first prime minister after the 1867 compromise that Elisabeth supported.

faq.q: How did the real Empress Sisi die?
faq.a: She was stabbed by an Italian anarchist, Luigi Lucheni, in Geneva on Sept. 10, 1898.

faq.q: Is Season 3 the last season of The Empress?
faq.a: Yes. Netflix renewed the show in January 2025 for a third and final season.

faq.q: Who plays Sisi in The Empress?
faq.a: Devrim Lingnau. Philip Froissant plays Emperor Franz Joseph.

faq.q: Did Maximilian really plot against Franz Joseph?
faq.a: There is no historical evidence that he did; that storyline is fiction.
